name: Jefferson Curl (Unloaded)
description: Slowly roll the spine forward and return to standing without added weight, practicing controlled spinal flexion.

items.content: Stand on the floor with feet hip-width apart and knees softly bent; use no added weight.
Gently nod the chin, then gradually round the upper, middle and lower back.
Let the arms hang and hips shift back; stop within a comfortable, controlled range.
Roll back up slowly, bringing the head upright last; do not bounce or force depth.
Keep breathing and stop if the movement causes pain, tingling or numbness.

stages.name: Standing
stages.description: Standing upright on the floor, feet hip-width apart, knees softly bent, arms hanging by the sides and hands empty.

stages.name: Rolled down
stages.description: Standing with softly bent knees, hips shifted slightly backward and spine rounded forward. Head and empty hands hang toward the floor, without reaching below foot level.
